# The task's image, pinned by digest.
# Setup runs at start from [environment.healthcheck]; environment/setup/ is its readable copy.
FROM docker.io/xiaomimimo/mimo-v2.6-rl-oss@sha256:5500f28f54d7b1440f51ccf8fde50ae3b9b278c1283894effe9c559474904f4a

# Author-time dependency repair; no agent-side dependency installation.
RUN /usr/local/bin/python3.12 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check \
    --no-cache-dir --no-deps \
    'https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/80/c5/0c06759b95747882bb50abda18f5fb48c3e9b0fbfc6ebc0e23550b52415d/stevedore-5.5.0-py3-none-any.whl#sha256=18363d4d268181e8e8452e71a38cd77630f345b2ef6b4a8d5614dac5ee0d18cf'

schema_version = "1.4"

[task]
name = "mimo-v2.6-rl/candidate-2684-security-appsec"
description = "Repair a real Bandit cross-module regression so Trojan Source findings retain precise source ranges through scanning…"
keywords = ["mimo-v2.6-rl", "terminal"]

[metadata]
adapter = "mimo_harbor 1.1.0"
category = "Terminal tasks"
domain = "terminal"
keywords = ["terminal", "Terminal tasks", "Terminal-bench style", "English", "static-analysis", "security", "python", "real-repair"]
original_allow_internet = false
reference_harness = "XiaomiMiMo/verl a2ad9f6 + XiaomiMiMo/mimoagent 467f0a1"
reference_step_limit = 500
source_dataset = "XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-RL-oss"
source_id = "candidate-2684-security-appsec"
source_revision = "639865fd3374018d6cb29b9fb82dd531406fcf5f"
title = "Repair a real Bandit cross-module regression so Trojan Source findings retain precise source ranges through scanning…"

[agent]
timeout_sec = 900.0

[verifier]
timeout_sec = 240.0
user = "root"

[environment]
workdir = "/app"
cpus = 1
memory_mb = 2048
storage_mb = 10240
network_mode = "public"
build_timeout_sec = 1800.0

[environment.healthcheck]
# one-time setup before the agent (environment/setup/setup.sh)
command = "bash -c 'test -f /var/lib/mimo/ready || { mkdir -p /var/lib/mimo && echo  | base64 -d | tar -xzf - -C /var/lib/mimo && bash /var/lib/mimo/setup.sh; }'"
timeout_sec = 1200.0
retries = 0
interval_sec = 5.0

rationale: Bake the missing generic stevedore dependency in the task's pinned Python 3.12 image before agent setup; do not provide reference code to nop, change tests, or permit agent network/dependency installs.
